text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Here is Hishi Amazon, the Queen of the
Amazons,
who truly made the Osaka Hai
her own!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has been raving about how you
ran
gallantly like a warrior!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, now that's a little bit of an
exaggeration.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
We would love to hear some of your
thoughts
regarding today's race!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I knew this race would bring in some
difficult
competition.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But that's all the more reason for me to
win!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready to push myself past the limit
and aim
even higher!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The pre-race interview greatly piques
the
audience's interest.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon is raring to go! She was
great at the
Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Queen of the Amazons," huh? The title
really
suits her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so the Yasuda Kinen arrives with fan

expectations higher than ever!
